      "code": "\n# Two-sample t-test power calculation\n# Design: Two independent normal groups with equal variances\n# Parameters:\n#   - Expected difference in means (effect): 4.3 dBA\n#   - Common standard deviation: 7.8 dBA\n#   - Sample size per group: 32\n#   - Significance level: 0.05\n#   - Test type: One-sided, pooled variance t-test\n\nlibrary(stats)\n\n# Input parameters\neffect_size_diff <- 4.3  # dBA\ncommon_sd <- 7.8          # dBA\nn_per_group <- 32\nalpha <- 0.05\nsidedness <- 1            # one-sided\n\n# Calculate Cohen's d effect size\ncohens_d <- effect_size_diff / common_sd\n\n# Degrees of freedom for two-sample t-test\ndf <- 2 * n_per_group - 2\n\n# Non-centrality parameter\n# For two equal-sample-size groups: lambda = cohens_d * sqrt(n/2)\nlambda <- cohens_d * sqrt(n_per_group / 2)\n\n# Critical value for one-sided test at alpha = 0.05\n# For one-sided test: qt(1 - alpha, df)\nt_critical <- qt(1 - alpha, df)\n\n# Power = P(t > t_critical | non-centrality = lambda) under alternative\n# This uses the non-central t-distribution\npower <- 1 - pt(t_critical, df, ncp = lambda)\n\n# Display results\ncat(\"Two-Sample t-Test Power Calculation\\n\")\ncat(\"====================================\\n\")\ncat(\"Design parameters:\\n\")\ncat(\"  Expected difference in means:\", effect_size_diff, \"dBA\\n\")\ncat(\"  Common standard deviation:\", common_sd, \"dBA\\n\")\ncat(\"  Sample size per group:\", n_per_group, \"participants\\n\")\ncat(\"  Total participants:\", 2 * n_per_group, \"\\n\")\ncat(\"  Significance level (alpha):\", alpha, \"\\n\")\ncat(\"  Test type: One-sided, pooled variance t-test\\n\")\ncat(\"\\nCalculated values:\\n\")\ncat(\"  Cohen's d effect size:\", round(cohens_d, 4), \"\\n\")\ncat(\"  Degrees of freedom:\", df, \"\\n\")\ncat(\"  Non-centrality parameter (lambda):\", round(lambda, 4), \"\\n\")\ncat(\"  Critical t-value:\", round(t_critical, 4), \"\\n\")\ncat(\"\\nResult:\\n\")\ncat(\"  Power:\", round(power, 4), \"\\n\")\n\n# Output JSON for structured reporting\nresults <- data.frame(\n  metric = \"power\",\n  value = power,\n  unit = \"probability\"\n)\n\ncat(\"\\nPOWER_AGENT_RESULT=\")\ncat(jsonlite::toJSON(list(results = results), auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15))\n",
